YOUR SCOPE (foundation layer — two other agents will build corrections workflow and offline sync on top of your seam):

1. NEW pure module `src/lib/attendance/lifecycle.ts`:
   - Export `ATTENDANCE_STATES` (const tuple): "initiated" | "authenticated" | "session_verified" | "presence_evaluated" | "risk_evaluated" | "step_up" | "verified" | "flagged" | "rejected" | "corrected", and type `AttendanceEventState`.

Also export a documented linear progression order for the intermediate pipeline (initiated→authenticated→session_verified→presence_evaluated→risk_evaluated→decision states) as `canFollowInPipeline(prev,next)` for future writers — keep it simple data, not machinery.
2. Extend `appendAttendanceEvent` in `convex/lib/attendance_event.ts`:
   - Accept full `state: AttendanceEventState`, `origin: "online"|"offline-faculty"|"mobile"` (default "online"), optional `correctsEventId?: Id<"attendance_events">`.

   - PER-INSTITUTION CHAIN: today it chains via global `by_seq` index; switch to per-institution sequencing like appendLedgerEvent. Add schema index `by_institution_seq` on attendance_events; remove `by_seq` index ONLY if nothing else references it (grep first — if referenced, leave the index and just stop using it here).
   - When correctsEventId is set, validate the target event exists, its state ∈ CORRECTIONABLE_STATES, and it has not itself been corrected (query `by_corrects_event` index for an existing corrected event referencing it).

A genuinely broken link mid-window still returns invalid. Apply the same anchoring to the new query in (6).
